title: Pullback commutes with cohomology restriction between nested opens
statement: Let g:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], A≤B opens of X, G an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and q≥0. Write R_AB for cohomology pullback along A→B followed by the inverse composition comparison to G restricted to A [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]; let R_AprimeBprime be the same map for g^{-1}A≤g^{-1}B and g^{-1}G. Write P_A and P_B for restricted pullback along g followed by the coefficient composition identifications. Then R_AprimeBprime(P_B(x))=P_A(R_AB(x)) for every x in H^q(B,G restricted to B), with no covering assumption.

proof.text: Write i:A→B, i_prime:g^{-1}A→g^{-1}B, a=g_A, b=g_B and c=i_prime ≫ b. Cancellation of the monomorphism B.ι, followed by the morphismRestrict_ι and homOfLE_ι identities, proves c=a ≫ i and (g^{-1}A).ι ≫ g=c ≫ B.ι.

For any a,b,c with c=a≫b and coefficient maps l and k, cohomologyMap_map and composition functoriality identify H(k)∘a^*∘H(l)∘b^* with H(upperStarComp(a,b).hom ≫ a^*(l) ≫ k)∘c^*. The private helper writes this as four equalities using Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply.

Use upperStarComp_hom_app_map_upperStarComp_inv_app for i_prime,b,B.ι, then map_upperStarComp_hom_app_upperStarComp_inv_app for i_prime,(g^{-1}B).ι,g. The composite coefficient map on the left reduces to upperStarComp(c,B.ι)^{-1} followed by upperStarComp((g^{-1}A).ι,g). For the right use upperStarComp_hom_app_map_upperStarComp_inv_app for a,i,B.ι and cancel upperStarComp(a,A.ι) with its inverse. The resulting coefficient maps coincide. These laws are the mate of associativity of the direct-image comparisons; their concrete Lean statements are proved in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.Pasting.

Apply the transported-composition helper to the two factorizations of c and rewrite their coefficient maps by the preceding equality. This is the claimed equality. The proof handles all degrees uniformly and adds no condition on A,B or g.

lean.statement: theorem openCohomologyPullback_restriction {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) {A B : X.Opens} (h : A ≤ B) (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} B.ι).obj G) q) : openCohomologyRestriction (g.preimage_mono h) ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G) q (openCohomologyPullback g B G q x) = openCohomologyPullback g A G q (openCohomologyRestriction h G q x)
